properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. musicjug's ideas §4 and §7, 2026-08-31, which are two halves of one complaint.

Every fix surfaced more gaps, all legitimate, and nothing said how far there was to go. "At no point could I tell the owner 'three more rounds and we're clean' versus 'this goes on for twenty.'" To a human watching an agent work, that reads as a treadmill even when every item is worth doing.

TWO IDEAS, and they answer different questions:
· **FRONTIER — how far.** "Fixing these 3 will likely surface ~5 more, mostly `undeclared_seam` and `unverified_*`; the phase-level gaps clear only when artifacts exist." Deliberately coarse.
· **PHASE HINT — what order.** A single line when components first appear: "next: declare dependencies, then interfaces on the coupled pairs, then verifications." The session got there by following five separate `loop_hint` strings across five detect rounds. The ordering was known the whole time and delivered one piece at a time, which is the same information shaped so it cannot be used as a plan.

WHAT IS CHEAP: `detect_gaps` already knows which phase transition triggers each gap source. That is what a frontier estimate is made of; nothing new has to be computed, only stated.

⚠️ THE COUNTER-ARGUMENT, and this project has a specific allergy to it: a frontier estimate is a FORECAST, and this design is careful about basis — `TemporalFact` distinguishes `measured` from `forecast` precisely because a projected number quoted later as a fact is how a design misleads itself. "~5 more" that turns out to be 25 is worse than saying nothing, and there is no way to bound the error honestly on a design nobody has seen before. Any build of this should carry its own basis the way `budget_report` does with `unstated` and `basis_coverage`.

📌 THE PHASE HINT HAS NONE OF THAT PROBLEM and is much the cheaper half. It states a known ordering rather than predicting a count. If only one of the two gets built, it should be that one.
properties.name: OPEN — should gap detection report a frontier ("~5 more, mostly seams") and a phase-transition plan, instead of one hint at a time?
properties.rationale: musicjug's idea, relayed. The forecast caution is this project's own existing doctrine about `basis`, not the reporter's.
